responsibility: This header defines the data structures and target callback interface for the hardware doloop reorganization framework. It describes hwloop_info_d, which records discovered loop blocks, nesting, incoming edges, head/tail/successor blocks, iteration register, labels, control-flow properties, and register usage, and it declares hw_doloop_hooks plus reorg_loops so targets can analyze loop_end patterns and perform late hardware-loop transformations.
same_name_distinction: Defines the data model and callback contract for hardware-loop reorganization, including hwloop_info_d fields and hw_doloop_hooks. The .cc file is the implementation that discovers loops and applies those hooks.
